entities.name: Grubhub 2026 Offsite In-Network Program
entities.description: A 2026 Grubhub commerce media program leveraging offsite in-network sponsored placements, takeovers, and carousels to generate net new revenue and expand marketing programs.

entities.name: Grubhub
entities.description: Food delivery brand running the Offsite In-Network sponsorship program to drive enterprise/SMB marketing growth and maximize margin via sponsored placements.

entities.name: Brand Command Center
entities.description: One-stop-shop platform used by Grubhub to manage assets, select properties, set CPMs, schedule, configure linkouts, and report on offsite in-network campaigns.

entities.name: Sponsored Post
entities.description: Offsite in-network sponsored post placement used in the GROW phase to extend contextual continuity for advertisers.

entities.name: Sponsored Takeover
entities.description: Offsite in-network takeover format that configures funnel and relevance, illustrated with the 'Summon The Food' creative brought to you by Grubhub.

entities.name: Extended O&O Sponsorship Takeover
entities.description: Offsite in-network takeover used in the MONETIZE phase to maximize margin via audience extension, with tiered earnings of +$40/+$20/+$20/+$20.

entities.name: iAB Compatible Session Takeover
entities.description: IAB-compatible session takeover supporting full funnel activation and journey orchestration with 300x600 and 300x250 ad units for partner, holding co., and house ads.

entities.name: First-Party Contextual Data
entities.description: Contextual mapping generated by aggregating content in the BCC, providing cookieless access to audiences at scale across the Genuin universe.

entities.name: Measurement Pixels
entities.description: Optional measurement pixels configured to produce verified attribution reports for offsite in-network campaigns.

entities.name: Attribution Reports
entities.description: Verified attribution outputs produced from configured measurement pixels to close the billing loop and report campaign performance.

entities.name: Brand Content
entities.description: AI-curated, fully moderated, endlessly shoppable brand content used to power offsite placements.

entities.name: Creator and Influencer Content
entities.description: Authentic, trusted content sourced from brand partners, creators, and influencers used in offsite in-network placements.

entities.name: Onsite Partner Creator Program
entities.description: Optional onsite creator program activated to support incentives, restaurants, and themes integrated into the offsite sponsorship.

entities.name: Enterprise Marketing Program
entities.description: Grubhub enterprise advertiser program expanded through the offsite in-network sponsorship initiative.

entities.name: SMB Marketing Program
entities.description: Grubhub small and medium business marketing program expanded through the offsite in-network sponsorship initiative.

entities.name: GROW Phase
entities.description: Program phase focused on extending contextual continuity through offsite in-network sponsored posts and takeovers.

entities.name: MONETIZE Phase
entities.description: Program phase focused on maximizing margin via audience extension using extended O&O sponsorship takeovers.

entities.description: Brand example referenced as a partner whose content can be used to power offsite in-network placements.

relationships.description: The Offsite In-Network program is owned and operated by Grubhub.
The program uses the Grubhub BCC account as a one-stop-shop for assets, property selection, CPMs, scheduling, linkouts, and reporting.
Sponsored Post placements are part of the offsite in-network program.
Sponsored Takeover placements are part of the offsite in-network program.
Extended O&O Sponsorship Takeovers are part of the program's MONETIZE phase.
IAB-compatible session takeovers are part of the offsite in-network program.
Sponsored Posts are positioned within the GROW phase of offsite in-network activity.
Sponsored Takeovers are positioned within the GROW phase of offsite in-network activity.
Extended O&O Sponsorship Takeovers are positioned within the MONETIZE phase to maximize margin.
Aggregating content in the BCC generates 1P contextual mapping across the Genuin universe.
The contextual mapping provides cookieless access to target audiences at scale.
Measurement pixels are optionally configured for the program to produce attribution reports.
Configured measurement pixels generate verified attribution reports.
AI-curated, fully moderated brand content is used to power offsite placements.
Authentic creator and influencer content from brand partners is used in the program.
An optional onsite partner creator program can be activated and integrated to support incentives, restaurants, and themes.
The offsite in-network program expands Grubhub's Enterprise marketing program.
The offsite in-network program expands Grubhub's SMB marketing program.
Blaze Pizza is referenced as a brand whose content participates in the offsite in-network program.
Wonder is shown as an example holding company advertiser slot within the iAB-compatible session takeover layout.
Peter Bavaro represents US Partnership Sales for the program.
Peter Bavaro is the partnership sales contact for the Grubhub offsite in-network program.
Grubhub aims to increase awareness of initiatives and offers with target audiences via the program.
